Container.Name: Hidden-Object-Hunt
Container.Overview: A hidden-object game website. As admin you upload a full-quality picture and mark the spots where objects are hidden. Visitors enter a nickname and race to find every object, with a live score (found/total), an HH:MM:SS timer, and a shared scoreboard of nickname and time. Uploaded images, the game config and the scoreboard are stored in the mapped Data and Uploads folders.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the /admin.html setup panel. CHANGE THIS.

Config.Name: Data (game + scoreboard)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the game config and scoreboard.

Config.Name: Uploads (images)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for uploaded full-quality images.
